title: Spectral convergence for critical FK–Ising planar maps
main_claim: For critical FK–Ising (q=2) spherical maps with n edges, the walk that moves at rate 1 to uniformly chosen half-edges, with time sped up by exactly n, converges jointly with the GHP limit (V_n, a_n d_n, mu_n) -> (S^2, D_h, mu_h). The convergence covers all ordered eigenvalues n*lambda_{n,j} -> Lambda_j(h) and heat traces locally uniformly in t>0, and the limit is Liouville Brownian motion on the unit-area sqrt(3)-quantum sphere, with conductivity and clock constant equal to 1.

issues.location: Sections 3, 5 (Prop. readout-extension, Prop. sphere-support, address/packing lemmas, Prop. flow-availability) and companion papers C and P
issues.description: The probabilistic inputs are taken from the companion papers [C] and [P] (October 3 revision) and were not checked line by line here. These are the local readout extension, the support transfer of null events from bilateral to sphere charts, the address and reachable-packing estimates behind the e^{N/40} overlap and the e^{N/10} circuit bills, and the deterministic-germ and field-equivalence lemmas. No concrete failing step was found. This is a dependency, not a demonstrated gap.
issues.evidence: 'The proof uses the canonical conformal companion [C] and the metric-measure companion [P], the latter in its revision of October 3, 2026. Their encoding, protected local laws, quantitative address and finite-view estimates, and geometric limits are the probabilistic inputs.'

coverage: Read in full: intro and main theorem, Sec 2 energy normalization, Sec 4 (finite EL/traffic identities, theorem statement, primal–dual obstruction proof, start of the bounds proof), Sec 5 (theorem statement, overlap lemma, segment cover, coarse/fine regime constants, dyadic estimate and threshold tightness/transfer), Sec 6 (tensor/scalar lemma, deterministic germ lemma from Sec 3, common coordinate, mixed-boundary duality lemma, harmonic compactness, square conductance, unit conductivity proof), Sec 9 entirely. Checked by hand: B_n=-2nL_n and its form equals the raw energy, so nu=2*n*lambda and nu_i=2*Lambda_i; the round Green function -(1/2pi)log chord (Laplacian of log(2 sin(theta/2)) is -1/2, flux 2pi), with mu double-centering giving -Delta G_mu=delta_y-mu; discrete column equation Q k(.,y)=delta_y-mu_n; Dykhne finite identity C_p*C_d=1 on a rectangular grid, so k_p=k_d with product 1 gives 1; EL = min squared traffic and the port/effective-resistance identity; primal–dual crossings meet only at paired edges, then Cauchy–Schwarz; exponent bookkeeping -1+1/5+1/40=-31/40>7/10; regime constants (m^{2u}, m^{3u/2} <= m^{1/(40B)} since u<1e-5/B, e^{5uBN} <= e^{N/10}); eigenvalue tail nu_i >= c*i^p via rank C0*2^j <= i/2; HS inverse-kernel lemma (unbounded-norm contradiction, tail summable since 2p>1, D-injectivity on doubly centered kernels with norm identity 2||k||); Lipschitz min-max for eigenvalues; heat-trace tail; GHP correspondence/coupling. Not verified: Secs 3 and 7–8 in detail (four-point voltage theorem, continuum form/Sobolev trace), aligned-annulus/edge-budget lemmas of Sec 4, Sec 5 address and flow-availability proofs, Lemma space-normalization.
sibling_notes: Family 211 board had four entries, all no_gap_found (partial): two companions (Canonical-conformal = [C], Metric-measure = [P]), the q=4 critical paper and the Linear Clock paper.
